 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of this clause is "**the imperative to cultivate critical consciousness**."
 
• The headword of this subject is "**imperative**," which is a **singular noun**. The phrase "to cultivate critical consciousness" acts as a modifier and does not change the number of the subject.
 
• According to the rules of **Subject-Verb Agreement**, a singular subject requires a singular verb. In the simple present tense, singular verbs end in '**-s**'. Therefore, "**remains**" is the correct form.
 
• "**Remain**" (Option 1) is a plural verb form and is grammatically incorrect for the singular "imperative."
